console_script_help.stdout:
usage: cleo [-h] [--print-config-template] [--print-harnesses-template]
            [--reset-to-main] [--project PROJECT] [--productivity]
            [--provider PROVIDER] [--cwd CWD] [--model MODEL]
            [--thread-id THREAD_ID | --resume THREAD_ID]
            [message]

Run the Cleo AI Agent local runtime.

positional arguments:
  message               Optional one-shot user message. Omit it to enter
                        interactive chat.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --print-config-template
                        Print a portable cleo.json template and exit.
  --print-harnesses-template
                        Print a portable harnesses.json template and exit.
  --reset-to-main       Reset this repository to the local main branch and
                        remove untracked or ignored files. Preserves local
                        Cleo and harness configuration.
  --project PROJECT     Bind this thread and its memory retrieval tools to a
                        project name.
  --productivity        Run an external agent harness through Cleo's
                        productivity adapter.
  --provider PROVIDER   Productivity harness provider. Defaults to
                        harnesses.json selection.
  --cwd CWD             Working directory for the productivity harness.
                        Defaults to this project root.
  --model MODEL         Optional productivity harness model override.
  --thread-id THREAD_ID
                        Conversation thread id used by the in-memory
                        checkpointer. Defaults to a generated id.
  --resume THREAD_ID    Resume a saved Cleo or productivity session by Cleo
                        session id.
